overview:
Karon is a west-coast beach area in Mueang Phuket district, between Patong to the north and Kata to the south. The two condominium projects listed here, both described as at or near Karon Beach, are on the Karon side of that stretch of coast.
Nearby places in the project data are limited for this area, so ask us for travel times to the beach, shops and the airport.
